title: Claude Code PreToolUse hook exits 1 but the tool call runs anyway
symptoms: PreToolUse:Bash hook error notice with 'Failed with non-blocking status code:' and the command still runs
A mistyped hook path shows '/bin/sh: ... No such file or directory' and the action goes ahead
A policy hook that prints JSON with a typo lets the action through
cause: Only exit code 2 blocks. Exit 1, any other code, a script that cannot start, or stdout JSON that fails to parse is a non-blocking error, so the action proceeds.
fix: Exit 2 with the reason on stderr to block, or return a JSON decision. On Claude Code v2.1.295 or later, set onFailure to block on policy hooks so a broken or missing script fails closed; older versions ignore the field.
apply:
# hook script
echo "Blocked: force push is not allowed" >&2
exit 2
# settings.json hook entry
{ "type": "command", "command": "\"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR\"/.claude/hooks/policy.sh", "onFailure": "block" }
affected: Claude Code hooks, as of 2026-10; onFailure requires v2.1.295 or later
